notes: Published-line 0.4.4 is a patch on 0.4.3. test, run wait, run status and run report treat a partial evaluation as grading still in progress, as the server reports it, and no longer infer from judge-job counts that grading has finished, so a passing run whose evaluation snapshot is still being saved keeps waiting instead of exiting 10; a finished inconclusive or not-run evaluation still exits 10 because the server reports it complete (AUG-434). It keeps the 0.4.3 fix: a hosted result whose evaluationStatus is error but whose outcome is failed is a known required-check failure: test, run wait, run status and run report report a failed assessment and exit 10 instead of 12; exit 12 stays for an evaluator error with no known required failure (a passed, inconclusive, error, null or unknown outcome), including when that error takes precedence over execution failure or cancellation (AUG-432). It keeps the 0.4.2 fixes: a verbatim data policy applies only the profile's credential and exact-local-secret rules, so permitted email addresses and phone numbers are uploaded unmasked (AUG-417), and run report counts a truncated reply excerpt as complete evidence, so a finished run exits 0 or 10 instead of 11 (AUG-418). It keeps the 0.4.1 fixes: real-data runs against connector-verified private targets (AUG-399), saved real-data suite scopes read from the server's revision (AUG-402), re-sending a saved completion after a hard kill and releasing a finished run (AUG-404), relay poll and status retries until the run deadline, journaled skipped_sequences and run_id in runner, test and recover --json errors (AUG-412), a five-minute cleanup wait for cancelled runs (AUG-405), finished partial evaluations and no-reply attempts that exit 10 (AUG-403), and email and phone redaction across every reply text field with international phone matching (AUG-400). It keeps the 0.4.0 Node.js 22.12 minimum (engines.node >=22.12; Node.js 20 reached end of life in April 2026, and npm 0.3.9 stays the last version for Node.js 20) and hosted authorized real-data testing: target add, target verify, target list, target pull, and scope create register and verify a workspace target and write its test scope into an aw-suite/3 file, and authorized hosted runs quote and create with the scope's registered boundary hash after checking augmentworks.yaml against that boundary. It reads the server's real-data documents as aw-real-data/1 defines them, vendored from main 16d767967c9d000b81f10ddb09800b0273277b68 with releaseEnabled and runtimeEnforced true. gate reads the server's aw-release-gate-read/1 decision, compare reads aw-semantic-comparison-read/1, test and run wait take pass or fail from the graded run report, baseline promote sends runId, and baseline create makes a workspace's first pin. It also keeps the 0.3.9 hosted run-scope lookup hardening (AUG-335), the 0.3.8 report consistency check (AUG-272), and the saved-suite customer path: native aw-customer-suite/1 upload translation, saved-suite v2 binding, authoritative v2 whole-suite gate receipts, durable execution IDs, cross-shard quote/run uniqueness, and non-destructive generated .env guidance.
